meta.confidence_note: All measurements marked 'measured' were taken on hardware during this session. Values marked 'inferred' or 'doc-only' come from SDK headers or documentation only.

phase0_baseline.property_count_note: Two extra codes in Remote (0x581, 0x582) correspond to live-view properties. Property count must not be used as a health assertion.

phase1_capture.trigger_command_note: S2/full-shutter release only. The MF baseline was measured with this command; an earlier revision of this file incorrectly recorded it as CrCommandId_S1andRelease. Timings below are unchanged. For autofocus capture use the explicit S1-gated flow, not S1andRelease, which is ungated.

s1_control.note: S1 = half-press/AF. Distinct from S2. SetDeviceProperty, not SendCommand.

s2_control.note: S2 = full release only. Does NOT assert S1/AF. In AF mode with only S2, SDK returns success but no exposure occurs.

s1_and_release_command.behavior: Combines S1+S2 in one SDK call. Ungated — exposure committed without caller inspection of focus state.
s1_and_release_command.note: Use explicit S1-gated flow instead. S1andRelease appropriate only as low-level escape hatch.

af_status_warning_channel.name: CrWarningExt_AFStatus
af_status_warning_channel.note: Second AF-state channel independent of FocusIndication property. Either may lead; no fixed ordering. Both must be subscribed. First valid Focused_* from either wins.

afc_timing.note: TrackingSubject_AF_C led Focused_AF_C by ~61ms in this run.

s1_cleanup_semantics.after_successful_capture: S1 reads back Unlocked without explicit write; S2 Up clears both stages
s1_cleanup_semantics.after_af_timeout_no_s2: S1 remains Locked; must explicitly release before next operation

repeated_afs_captures.description: Three sequential AF-S captures through S1-gated flow in clean sessions
repeated_afs_captures.content_id_note: IDs monotonically increasing but not guaranteed contiguous. Detection must use new_id > baseline.

ram_postview.notes: Full-resolution JPEG at 4240x2832. SetDeviceSetting(EnablePostView) is rejected in Remote mode (0x8402), but postview is delivered anyway when destination is Host+Card. Configuration acceptance and delivery are independent capabilities.

screennail.content_id_source: GetRemoteTransferContentsInfoList for newest date, select max content ID
screennail.notes: Best balance of size and resolution for reconstruction preview. Exact-still association confirmed by content ID matching.

thumbnail.notes: 160x120 is too small for reconstruction. Slower than screennail despite smaller size; overhead dominates.

live_view_frame_fallback.notes: Fastest visual feedback but NOT tied to exact captured still. Stream pauses around capture event. Use as immediate preview; replace with screennail or postview when exact-still data arrives.

small_size_transfer.notes: Probe crashed due to stale handle bug (handle used after list Release). Camera recovered cleanly. Requires ContentsTransfer mode (reconnect from Remote). Marked as optional optimization, not required for initial architecture.

phase1_capability_matrix.description: Control mode and save destination are independent axes that each gate functionality
phase1_capability_matrix.key_finding: Remote + HostCard is the recommended single-session mode for SPTFS: provides live view, AF, capture, and exact RAM postview without a mode switch. RemoteTransfer is required only for content index / screennail access.
phase1_capability_matrix.postview_config_vs_delivery: Postview configuration acceptance and postview delivery are independent capabilities. SetDeviceSetting rejection does not imply non-delivery.

phase1_mode_transitions.mode_change_requires: Disconnect + ReleaseDevice + re-Connect with new mode

phase1_live_view.sdk_buffer_ownership: SDK-internal background buffer; copy out immediately, do not hold reference across frames
phase1_live_view.remote_transfer_lv_error: GetLiveViewImage returns CrError_Generic; GetLiveViewImageInfo reports zero buffer. Tested 100+ attempts, multiple processes.

usb_unplug_replug_idle.operator_action_required: Camera displayed USB mode prompt; operator selected Remote Shooting

usb_unplug_replug_during_live_view.failed_polls_during_loss: returned SDK errors normally, no native crash

phase1_reconnect.critical_rule: With CrReconnecting_ON the bridge must not require OnDisconnected before accepting a subsequent OnConnected. State machine: Connected -> Reconnecting -> Reconnected (second OnConnected) without intermediate Disconnected.
phase1_reconnect.session_already_opened_0x8210: Observed on rapid consecutive connects. Transient; add short delay between disconnect and reconnect.

phase1_properties.unknown_code_handling: Preserve unknown numeric codes; do not discard unrecognized properties

phase1_repeated_exact_still.description: Three deliberate captures in separate clean sessions to verify exact-still association by content ID
phase1_repeated_exact_still.baseline: Pre-capture baseline was the immediately preceding content in the index
observations: No busy response, ambiguous callback, or previous-shot image observed
Long-session callback accumulation not tested; single-shot probe used for safety

verdict_rationale: 95% of the API is extern-C, works with ctypes directly
C ABI shim (~300 lines C++) isolates IDeviceCallback and ICrCameraObjectInfo vtable dispatch
SDK callbacks never enter Python directly; shim queues events into ring buffer
Natural isolation point for Sony proprietary headers
Works across Windows, Linux (ARM/x64), macOS SDK variants
phase2_bridge.runner_up_reason: Faster initial Windows-only prototype but requires per-Python-version .pyd builds and does not solve object lifetime problem
ruled_out: cffi (no advantage over ctypes for this surface)
phase2_bridge.calling_convention: MSVC x64 ABI, all public functions extern-C, no name mangling
phase2_bridge.callback_thread: SDK-internal thread; callbacks must not block; route to event queue

ownership_rules.ICrCameraObjectInfo_from_enum: owned by enum, do not separately release
ownership_rules.content_handle_lists: caller, separate Release call per list type

shim_design_principles: Opaque generation-checked IDs, never expose raw Sony pointers
Python polls/drains events, does not receive direct callbacks
Copy content metadata immediately while Sony handle lists are valid
Copy-out image functions with explicit capacity and returned byte count
RAII for every Sony list, device, property array, image object
Explicit connection states: connecting, connected, reconnecting, closing, closed
Explicit session concept: control_mode + destination + observed capabilities
Preserve unknown property codes; never discard unrecognized numeric codes

session_concept.camera: Persistent identity — model, firmware, transport, static capabilities. Survives mode transitions.
session_concept.session: One active CRSDK connection. Has control_mode, destination, and observed runtime capabilities.
session_concept.note: Changing Remote <-> RemoteTransfer replaces the session, not the camera. The Python Camera object can logically persist across reconnects.

fx3a_quirks.description: Model enum is ILME_FX3A, distinct from ILME_FX3
GetRemoteTransferContentsInfoList with maxNums=1 returns oldest record for date, not newest
fx3a_quirks.impact: Must request all records for the date, select by max content ID or creation timestamp
fx3a_quirks.confirmed_by: probe code inspection and behavior during screennail characterization

fx3a_quirks.description: Content handle lists must be copied and released while valid; reuse after Release causes access violation
fx3a_quirks.impact: Shim must copy metadata on retrieval and never expose raw handles
fx3a_quirks.confirmed_by: crash during small-transfer probe; camera recovered cleanly

fx3a_quirks.description: CrWarning_Connect_Reconnecting fires on disconnect, not OnDisconnected
fx3a_quirks.impact: State machine must handle reconnect without intermediate Disconnected state
fx3a_quirks.confirmed_by: software and physical reconnect characterization; USB unplug/replug (idle and live-view)

fx3a_quirks.impact: Add short delay between disconnect and next connect attempt

fx3a_quirks.description: GetRemoteTransferContentsInfoList does not accept null capture-date pointer even for all-dates query
fx3a_quirks.impact: Must enumerate capture dates first with GetRemoteTransferCapturedDateList, then query per date
fx3a_quirks.confirmed_by: InvalidParameter return on null date pointer in probe

fx3a_quirks.description: After USB unplug/replug, camera displays a USB mode selection prompt on its screen
fx3a_quirks.impact: Operator must manually select Remote Shooting before the SDK can reconnect; automated unattended recovery is not possible without operator intervention
fx3a_quirks.confirmed_by: observed during USB unplug/replug while idle test

fx3a_quirks.description: CrCommandId_Release (S2) does not assert S1/AF; in AF mode, SDK returns success but no exposure occurs
fx3a_quirks.impact: Must use explicit S1 SetDeviceProperty to assert AF before issuing S2 for autofocus capture
fx3a_quirks.confirmed_by: AF-S test with Release-only command — no Captured_Event, no content

fx3a_quirks.description: TrackingSubject_AF_C is an in-progress AF-C state, not a focus-success state
fx3a_quirks.impact: S2 must not be issued on TrackingSubject; wait for Focused_AF_C. In measured run TrackingSubject led Focused by ~61ms.

fx3a_quirks.description: OnWarningExt carries CrWarningExt_AFStatus (0x60001) as a second AF-state channel independent of FocusIndication
fx3a_quirks.impact: Subscribe to both; either may lead the other with no fixed ordering. First valid Focused_* from either wins.

fx3a_quirks.description: S1 remains Locked after AF timeout if S2 was never issued
fx3a_quirks.impact: Timeout cleanup path must explicitly release S1; successful S2 Up clears both stages automatically

fx3a_quirks.description: GetLiveViewImage returns CrError_Generic in RemoteTransfer mode; GetLiveViewImageInfo reports zero buffer
fx3a_quirks.impact: Live view is not available in RemoteTransfer mode. Live view requires Remote mode.

fx3a_quirks.description: SetDeviceSetting(EnablePostView) is rejected (0x8402) in Remote mode, but postview bytes are still delivered when destination is Host+Card
fx3a_quirks.impact: Postview configuration acceptance and postview delivery are independent capabilities; check delivery by attempting and observing, not by inferring from config acceptance

fx3a_quirks.description: Content IDs are monotonically increasing but not guaranteed contiguous
fx3a_quirks.impact: New-content detection must use new_id > baseline_id, not new_id == baseline_id + 1

sptfs_recommendations.rationale: Single session providing live view, AF, capture, and exact RAM postview. RemoteTransfer needed only for content index / screennail access; requires disconnect/reconnect.
sptfs_recommendations.preview_strategy: Use live-view frame (~504ms) as immediate feedback, replace with RAM postview (~683ms) when available in Remote+HostCard, or screennail (~902ms) via RemoteTransfer session if needed
sptfs_recommendations.best_fast_preview: RAM postview (4240x2832, ~4.64MB, ~683ms) — exact-still, available in Remote+HostCard without mode switch

ks2_comparison.verdict: Sony does not provide a sub-200ms small-JPEG exact-still path. Screennail is the functional equivalent at ~900ms. Live-view frame bridges the gap for visual feedback. RAM postview (683ms) provides high-resolution exact-still faster than screennail but at ~4.64MB.
